classification_summary.1_DOCUMENTED_FACT: 01-Mar package association; authenticated controlled Annex 08-D and its embedded-copy hash; recovered HKI 25-Nov-2019 captures; existing controlled Club Sei/Sun Park commercial evidence.
classification_summary.2_PRIMARY_SOURCE_CORPORATE_REGULATORY_RE: BORME Meeting Point chronology; CNMC BLUESEA/MPS control acquisition.
classification_summary.3_CONTEMPORANEOUS_MEDIA_PROFESSIONAL_SEL: 2016 LABRANDA Marieta role; Acosta Matos project pages; Club Sei announcements; 2025 professional activity.
classification_summary.4_CORROBORATED_CONNECTION: Recurring Meeting Point/LABRANDA–Acosta Matos owner/operator/executive relationship before 2018 and renewed post-FTI continuity.
classification_summary.5_INVESTIGATIVE_INFERENCE_HYPOTHESIS: Test whether the 01-Mar visit related to evaluation, measurements, project preparation, management or commercialisation; no criminal conclusion.
classification_summary.6_USER_ALLEGATION: Wider alleged causal relationship between pre-title access/project preparation, later material control, commercialisation and adjudication remains separately attributed.
classification_summary.7_UNRESOLVED_REQUIRES_AUTHENTICATION: Identity, consent/authority, exact capacity, purpose, originals/EXIF, project outputs, contracts, first dates, custody and the version relationship between Annex 08-D's embedded copy and PD-SP-DOC-0005.
